## Content & Learning Objectives

### 1️⃣ When a good reconstruction hides a concept

> ##### Learning Objectives
>
> - Implement the exact word-property encoder/decoder and show how apple reconstructs despite missing the general-A feature.

### 2️⃣ Measure coverage, not just top examples

> ##### Learning Objectives
>
> - Measure precision, recall, overlap and absorption candidates; use the missing apple positive to falsify the dashboard label.

### 3️⃣ Attribute and ablate attention-output features

> ##### Learning Objectives
>
> - Separate signed per-head cancellation from direct logit effects; compare error-preserving feature/group ablation margin drops with unrelated-B controls.

### 4️⃣ Build a dashboard that can be wrong

> ##### Learning Objectives
>
> - Validate the offline interchange panel and reject invalid values; change a word or coefficient and inspect how the visible coverage claim changes.
